picks.title: Ex-Tesla team raises $12.5M to put supply chains on autopilot
picks.why_it_matters: Strong founder pedigree (ex-Tesla) combined with enterprise traction at DoorDash and HelloFresh signals agentic AI is moving from hype to real B2B adoption in supply chain—a massive market ripe for automation.

picks.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
picks.why_it_matters: Peak XV increasing seed check sizes reflects the rising Series A bar globally, signaling early-stage VCs must write larger checks and provide more runway as competition for breakout companies intensifies.

picks.title: Insurtech Outmarket raises $34.5M just months after prior round
picks.why_it_matters: Rapid back-to-back funding suggests AI-powered workflow automation in insurance is hitting strong product-market fit—a signal that similar vertical AI plays in other paper-heavy industries may be timely.
